notes.text: Preserve the attributed story and divine subject.

The full Kohelet Rabbah story explicitly supplies the Holy One as the cause of the sunshine. The short Warsaw sentence leaves the subject implicit, which editorial context can make explicit without making a historical claim.
The immediate named account explicitly identifies God as the subject of the verb for making the sun shine. This clarifies the implicit subject in the Warsaw narrative.
